description: Borderline flip at touchdown: ride the generated launch lip at x=18464 and hold one front flip so the release sits right on the land/bail-out boundary.
notes: VERIFIED 2026-11-21 as a landing-GRADE boundary (not a crash boundary - both variants still land). Established by sweep, not assertion: releasing the front flip at 3100 ms lands 'good' at tick 382 (impact 24.4 deg, air 958 ms); releasing the same flip one 100 ms step later at 3200 ms lands 'sloppy' at 69 deg. So a small handling change flips this canary's landing grade, which is the sensitivity the gate needs. Do not retune toward a clean landing - the boundary IS the fixture.
